meta.source: London Datastore: Interim 2024-based housing-led population projections (GLA Demography)
meta.attribution: GLA Demography, Open Data Commons Attribution License. The GLA cannot warrant the quality or accuracy of the data (London Datastore terms).
meta.method: lds-harvest-auto.mjs run 2wwq4: resources chosen by the written rules; every row of every sheet or CSV read (CSV over 20 MB streamed and not stored; large xlsx streamed with ExcelJS); a row is kept when it is a zone row (harvest-log.json meta.rules.zone_row): zone OA/LSOA/MSOA/ward code, zone postcode or postcode sector, zone UPRN or TOID, or coordinates in the 3D model box. zone_keys gives the key that matched, row by row. header_rows: the rows above the first data row.
selection_notes: hand rule: the persons and components-of-change sheets of the three variants; the male and female sheets split the persons rows (13.8 MB with them, single year of age x ward x sex)
